message.content:
I = ∫ 2*exp(x)*cos(x) dx

Using the standard integral:
∫ exp(x)*cos(x) dx = (exp(x)*(sin(x)+cos(x)))/2 + C

So:
I = 2 * ((exp(x)*(sin(x)+cos(x)))/2) + C
I = exp(x)*(sin(x)+cos(x)) + C

<answer>exp(x)*(sin(x)+cos(x)) + C</answer>
